unlisted_practices: Conduct rigorous clinical evaluations of AI-supported self-help and triage tools in diverse, real-world primary care settings before large-scale adoption.
Establish clear protocols for handling technological failures, user training, and assignment of responsibility when patients rely on AI-supported health systems.
Address legal liability, continuity of care, training requirements, and compensation before adopting a human-in-the-loop health buddy role at scale.

screen.reason: This is a commentary exploring the role of AI, LLMs, chatbots, and wearables in supporting the Norwegian general practitioner scheme and empowering patients.
